title: Storage conditions and passages alter IL-6 secretion in C26 adenocarcinoma cell lines
author: Norden, Devine, et al.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Lyse cells and brain sections with Tri‑Reagent (Sigma) and isolate RNA following the Tri‑Reagent protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe the isolated RNA to cDNA using the High Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit (Applied Biosystems) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Run quantitative PCR
steps.instruction: Set up quantitative PCR reactions using the Applied Biosystems Assay‑on‑Demand Gene Expression protocol and amplify the experimental cDNA on an ABI PRISM 7300 sequence detection system (Applied Biosystems) with real‑time PCR.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Normalize Ct values to the GAPDH reference gene, calculate fold change using the comparative threshold cycle (ΔΔCt) method, and express results as fold change from control.
